data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that notifies when the system clipboard text changes on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a static API to register callbacks that are invoked whenever the clipboard content is updated while the app is running. Supports registering multiple callbacks and removing them individually or all at once.
use_when: You need real‑time clipboard change notifications inside a running app
You want a simple callback‑based API without streams or code generation
avoid_when: The app may be backgrounded or not running (monitoring stops)
You require clipboard access on Android 10+ when the app is not in focus
strengths: Works on both Android and iOS with a single API
No additional build steps or code generation required
weaknesses: Does not work when the app is not in the foreground
